export interface Principal {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly roles: readonly string[];
  readonly tenantId?: string;
  readonly entitlements?: readonly string[];
  readonly attributes?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export interface AuthzResource {
  readonly type: string;
  readonly id?: string;
  readonly ownerField?: string;
  readonly ownerId?: string;
  readonly relation?: string;
}

export interface AuthzEntitlement {
  readonly code: string;
  readonly source?: string;
  readonly matchParam?: string;
}

export interface AuthzDecisionQuery {
  readonly principal: Principal;
  readonly callerKind: string;
  readonly action: string;
  readonly scope?: string;
  readonly policyRef?: string;
  readonly context: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
  readonly resource?: AuthzResource;
  readonly entitlements?: readonly AuthzEntitlement[];
}

export interface AuthzDecisionResult {
  readonly allowed: boolean;
  readonly code?: string;
}

/** Pluggable PDP seam: bridge to auth-core RoleResolver, Workday Org-Role, OPA, or OpenFGA. */
export interface AuthorizationPort {
  readonly decide: (query: AuthzDecisionQuery) => boolean;
}

/** Pluggable qualification / certificate entitlement checker (e.g. exam certificates, creator tiers). */
export interface EntitlementPort {
  readonly hasEntitlement: (principal: Principal, entitlement: AuthzEntitlement, matchValue?: unknown) => boolean;
}

export interface HttpAuthority {
  readonly authenticate: (req: HttpRequestDto) => Principal | null;
  readonly authorize: (principal: Principal, route: RouteDescriptor, req?: HttpRequestDto) => boolean;
  readonly authorizeDetailed?: (principal: Principal, route: RouteDescriptor, req?: HttpRequestDto) => AuthzDecisionResult;
  readonly verifyCsrf?: (req: HttpRequestDto) => boolean;
}

export const allowAllAuthority: HttpAuthority = {
  authenticate: () => ({ id: "system-default", roles: ["*"] }),
  authorize: () => true,
  authorizeDetailed: () => ({ allowed: true }),
  verifyCsrf: () => true,
};

export function resolvePrincipalField(principal: Principal, key: string): unknown {
  if (key === "id" || key === "principal.id") return principal.id;
  if (key === "tenantId" || key === "principal.tenantId") return principal.tenantId;
  if (key === "roles" || key === "principal.roles") return principal.roles;
  if (key.startsWith("principal.attributes.")) return principal.attributes?.[key.slice(21)];
  if (key.startsWith("attributes.")) return principal.attributes?.[key.slice(11)];
  return principal.attributes?.[key];
}

export function extractAuthzContext(route: RouteDescriptor, req?: HttpRequestDto, principal?: Principal): Record<string, unknown> {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { ...(req?.query ?? {}), ...(req?.body ?? {}) };
  for (const cp of route.contextParams ?? []) {
    if (cp.from.startsWith("param.")) out[cp.name] = payload[cp.from.slice(6)];
    else if (cp.from.startsWith("token.")) {
      const key = cp.from.slice(6);
      out[cp.name] = key === "tenantId" ? principal?.tenantId : principal?.attributes?.[key];
    } else if (cp.from.startsWith("header.")) {
      out[cp.name] = req?.headers?.[cp.from.slice(7)];
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export function extractAuthzResource(route: RouteDescriptor, req?: HttpRequestDto, principal?: Principal): AuthzResource | undefined {
  if (!route.resource) return undefined;
  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { ...(req?.query ?? {}), ...(req?.body ?? {}) };
  let id: string | undefined;
  const idFrom = route.resource.idFrom;
  if (idFrom) {
    if (idFrom.startsWith("param.")) {
      const v = payload[idFrom.slice(6)];
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null) id = String(v);
    } else if (idFrom.startsWith("header.")) {
      const v = req?.headers?.[idFrom.slice(7)];
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null) id = String(v);
    } else if (idFrom.startsWith("token.")) {
      const key = idFrom.slice(6);
      const v = key === "tenantId" ? principal?.tenantId : principal?.attributes?.[key];
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null) id = String(v);
    }
  }
  let ownerId: string | undefined;
  if (route.resource.ownerField) {
    const rawOwner = req?.stateSnapshot?.[route.resource.ownerField];
    if (rawOwner !== undefined && rawOwner !== null) ownerId = String(rawOwner);
  }
  return {
    type: route.resource.type,
    ...(id !== undefined ? { id } : {}),
    ...(route.resource.ownerField ? { ownerField: route.resource.ownerField } : {}),
    ...(ownerId !== undefined ? { ownerId } : {}),
    ...(route.resource.relation ? { relation: route.resource.relation } : {}),
  };
}

export function createRoleBasedAuthority(
  authenticate: (req: HttpRequestDto) => Principal | null,
  pdp?: AuthorizationPort,
  verifyCsrf?: (req: HttpRequestDto) => boolean,
  entitlementPort?: EntitlementPort,
): HttpAuthority {
  const authorizeDetailed = (principal: Principal, route: RouteDescriptor, req?: HttpRequestDto): AuthzDecisionResult => {
    if (route.authzMode === "public") return { allowed: true };
    const resource = extractAuthzResource(route, req, principal);
    const entitlements = route.requiresEntitlement ?? [];
    if (route.authzMode === "external-pdp") {
      if (!pdp) return { allowed: false, code: "NOT_AUTHORIZED" };
      const ok = pdp.decide({
        principal,
        callerKind: route.callerKind ?? "human",
        action: route.action ?? route.operation,
        scope: route.scope,
        policyRef: route.policyRef,
        context: extractAuthzContext(route, req, principal),
        ...(resource ? { resource } : {}),
        ...(entitlements.length > 0 ? { entitlements } : {}),
      });
      return ok ? { allowed: true } : { allowed: false, code: "NOT_AUTHORIZED" };
    }
    const allowed = route.allowedRoles ?? [];
    const isWildcard = principal.roles.includes("*");
    if (allowed.length > 0 && !isWildcard && !principal.roles.some(r => allowed.includes(r))) {
      return { allowed: false, code: "NOT_AUTHORIZED" };
    }
    if (!isWildcard && route.resource) {
      if (route.resource.ownerField) {
        const expectedOwner = resolvePrincipalField(principal, route.resource.ownerPrincipalKey ?? "id");
        const actualOwner = req?.stateSnapshot?.[route.resource.ownerField];
        if (expectedOwner === undefined || actualOwner === undefined || actualOwner === null || String(actualOwner) !== String(expectedOwner)) {
          return { allowed: false, code: "FORBIDDEN_RESOURCE" };
        }
      }
      if (route.authzMode === "resource-policy" && (route.policyRef || !route.resource.ownerField)) {
        if (!pdp) return { allowed: false, code: "FORBIDDEN_RESOURCE" };
        const ok = pdp.decide({
          principal,
          callerKind: route.callerKind ?? "human",
          action: route.action ?? route.operation,
          scope: route.scope,
          policyRef: route.policyRef,
          context: extractAuthzContext(route, req, principal),
          ...(resource ? { resource } : {}),
          ...(entitlements.length > 0 ? { entitlements } : {}),
        });
        if (!ok) return { allowed: false, code: "FORBIDDEN_RESOURCE" };
      }
    }
    if (!isWildcard && entitlements.length > 0) {
      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { ...(req?.query ?? {}), ...(req?.body ?? {}) };
      const grants = new Set<string>(principal.entitlements ?? []);
      for (const ent of entitlements) {
        const matchVal = ent.matchParam ? payload[ent.matchParam] : undefined;
        const has = entitlementPort
          ? entitlementPort.hasEntitlement(principal, ent, matchVal)
          : (grants.has(ent.code) || (matchVal !== undefined && (grants.has(`${ent.code}:${String(matchVal)}`) || grants.has(`${ent.code}:*`))));
        if (!has) return { allowed: false, code: "ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED" };
      }
    }
    return { allowed: true };
  };
  return {
    authenticate,
    authorize(principal: Principal, route: RouteDescriptor, req?: HttpRequestDto): boolean {
      return authorizeDetailed(principal, route, req).allowed;
    },
    authorizeDetailed,
    verifyCsrf: verifyCsrf ?? (() => true),
  };
}

  readonly headers?: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>;
  readonly query?: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>;
  readonly body?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
  readonly stateSnapshot?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
  readonly principal?: Principal;
}

  readonly status: number;
  readonly headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  readonly body: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export interface RouteContextParam {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly from: string;
}

export interface RouteResourceSpec {
  readonly type: string;
  readonly idFrom?: string;
  readonly ownerField?: string;
  readonly ownerPrincipalKey?: string;
  readonly relation?: string;
}

export interface RoutePrincipalBinding {
  readonly param: string;
  readonly from: string;
}

export interface RouteRowScopeSpec {
  readonly kind: string;
  readonly matchField?: string;
  readonly principalKey?: string;
}

export interface RouteDescriptor {
  readonly method: "GET" | "POST";
  readonly path: string;
  readonly story: string;
  readonly operation: string;
  readonly callerKind?: string;
  readonly authzMode?: string;
  readonly action?: string;
  readonly scope?: string;
  readonly allowedRoles?: readonly string[];
  readonly policyRef?: string;
  readonly contextParams?: readonly RouteContextParam[];
  readonly resource?: RouteResourceSpec;
  readonly bindPrincipal?: readonly RoutePrincipalBinding[];
  readonly requiresEntitlement?: readonly AuthzEntitlement[];
  readonly rowScope?: RouteRowScopeSpec;
}

export function mapRejectionToHttpStatus(code: string): number {
  const upper = String(code ?? "").toUpperCase();
  if (upper.includes("UNAUTHORIZED") || upper.includes("CSRF") || upper.includes("AUTH")) return 401;
  if (upper.includes("FORBIDDEN")) return 403;
  if (upper.includes("CONFLICT") || upper.includes("ALREADY")) return 409;
  if (upper.includes("NOT_FOUND") || upper.includes("UNKNOWN")) return 404;
  return 400;
}

export function jsonResponse(status: number, body: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): HttpResponseDto {
  return {
    status,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" },
    body,
  };
}
